title: Specialization: Hospital Medical Staff
scenario: In a hospital system, a generic Doctor can "View Patient Records". A Cardiologist is a specialized type of Doctor who inherits all capabilities of a Doctor, and additionally can "Perform Heart Angioplasty".
goal: Create an Actor Generalization from Cardiologist to Doctor, and connect the appropriate actors to their specific use cases with Associations.
learningObjective: Model Generalization (inheritance). Generalization has an open triangle arrow pointing from the child/specialized entity to the parent/general entity.
hints: Cardiologist is a specialized Doctor. Draw a Generalization edge pointing FROM Cardiologist TO Doctor.
Doctor interacts with "View Patient Records" via Association.
Cardiologist interacts with "Perform Heart Angioplasty" via Association.
solutionExplanation: Actor Generalization signifies that the child actor can perform everything the parent actor can, plus their own specialized use cases. The arrow has a hollow triangular head pointing toward the general parent.

solutions.description: Cardiologist generalizes Doctor; both connected to their use cases
